newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI STOCKS SEEN LACKLUSTER ON LIMITED INCENTIVES.
newsitem.headline: THAI STOCKS SEEN LACKLUSTER ON LIMITED INCENTIVES.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to move sideways on Thursday on the absence of fresh new incentives and foreign lingering concern over uncertainty for regional currencies, brokers said.
"I don't think the market will move much as there are no positive news. Volatility of regional currencies also weakened foreign buying interest," said a trader at a local brokerage.
The composite SET index finished just 0.48 points up at 632.73 on sluggish 4.17 billion baht turnover.
